title: Lofts at 30th - Modern Life - Walk to Restaurants
description:
Welcome to Modern Life in Lofts at 30th, where luxury urban design meets the West End, giving the most high-end Music City experience. Nestled in the vibrant neighborhood of the West End corridor, this stunning open floor, intricately designed loft is within walking distance to hundreds of local restaurants, breweries, and some of Nashville's HOTTEST attractions. Only a 5-minute Uber/Lyft ride to Broadway! The ultimate Nashville getaway awaits.

The space
IF YOU ARE INTERESTED IN THIS PROPERTY, PLEASE READ THE LISTING ENTIRELY. By booking, the guest agrees they have read all the details about the property and agree to our terms and conditions. 

⭐ Amenities:
- Tucked away in the vibrant West End Corridor
- Just a 5-minute stroll to Centennial Park — perfect for picnics or a morning jog
- Just a 5-minute drive to Broadway’s buzzing bars and live music scene!
- Smart TVs in the living room and bedroom ready for your next Netflix binge
- In-unit washer and dryer so you can pack light
- Lobby with a comfy lounge area to relax or wait for your ride
- Elevator access because vacation should be easy

🛋️ Living Areas:
- Open-concept living room designed for lounging and laughter
- Couch and lounge chair combo made for unwinding after a day of exploring
- Smart TV for movie marathons or catching the big game
- Coffee table ideal for late-night snacks or board games

🍽️ Kitchen & Dining:
- Fully equipped kitchen with everything you need to whip up a favorite meal
- Shiny stainless steel appliances that make cooking a breeze
- Fridge, dishwasher, oven, 4-burner stove, microwave, and toaster
- Drip coffee maker with coffee provided to start your mornings off right
- Bar seating for 3, perfect for chatting with the chef or sipping cocktails
- Kitchen Starter Kit: 2 dishwashing tablet, dish soap, 1 dish sponge, 2 laundry detergent pods, disinfectant wipes, 2 paper towel rolls, 2 trash bags, 1 coffee bag, and 4 coffee filters

🛌 Bedrooms & Bathrooms:
- Primary Bedroom (4th Floor): 1 King Bed with Smart TV and Closet Space
- Additional Sleeping Arrangement: 1 Trifold Bed
- Primary Bathroom (4th Floor): Single Vanity with Shower/Tub Combo
- Bathroom Starter Kits: 1 Shampoo, 1 Conditioner, 1 Body Wash, 1 Body Bar Soap, 1 Hand Bar Soap, 1 Makeup Wipe, 1 Liner for Trash Can.

🚗 Parking:
- Parking garage with 1 parking spot Available
- Additional street parking is available first-come, first-served  

❗️Notes to Guests & Important Details:
- Please note this unit is located on the 4th floor of the building; however, an elevator is available on-site.
- We offer multiple rooms for this building; each unit is designed to provide a beautiful/comfortable place to stay. While our rooms remain consistent, the layout and design may vary.
